payload.text: **Fix 0085 after 0082 closes, on hv's ruling that it is filed and closed out rather than parked.** The provenance line is passed at one of the five gate openers; the fix lands in lib/resolve (906), lib/gatecmd (134 and 151) and lib/cmd/fullcycle (770), and either makes lib/resolve:894-896's parity claim true or deletes it. vc sequenced it after the review because those are files dc is reviewing, and a reviewer reading a file it has just rewritten is not a second pair of eyes.
